title: Zyngram Overview
content: The supplied Zyngram materials present Zyngram as a unified digital economic ecosystem connecting people, businesses, services and opportunities. The franchise brochure describes a combined physical and digital franchise ecosystem and presents 278 service categories. The Zyngrammers presentation presents the platform around themes of people, ownership, opportunity, transparency, security and participation.

title: Vision, Mission and Core Values
content: Vision: To become a global digital ecosystem that empowers businesses, individuals and communities with accessible services, technology and opportunities across regions. Mission: To create a unified platform that brings businesses, people and services together, enabling growth, income opportunities and a better quality of life. Core values shown in the brochure include People First, Trust & Transparency, Innovation, Opportunities and Social Impact.

title: Zyngram Ecosystem and Platform Structure
content: The ecosystem combines people, businesses, services and opportunities on one platform. The supplied materials describe both physical and digital franchise networks as connected parts of the broader Zyngram ecosystem. The materials also describe wallet/reward concepts, subscriptions, business onboarding, service usage, referrals, digital opportunities and community participation.

title: User Groups and Participation
content: The presentation describes participation opportunities for students, homemakers, unemployed people, employed people, teenagers, retired persons, leaders, business owners, entrepreneurs, political aspirants and content creators. These descriptions are presented in the source as opportunity-oriented use cases and should not be interpreted as guarantees of income or results.

title: India Vision and Social Impact
content: The presentation describes an India-focused vision involving local business activity, entrepreneurship, digital empowerment and economic growth. Themes presented include Vocal for Local, Atmanirbhar Bharat, Digital Empowerment, Entrepreneurship for All and Economic Growth. The presentation also highlights education, healthcare, community development and broader social impact.

title: Zyngram Foundation
content: The presentation describes Zyngram Foundation as a social-impact initiative focused on giving back. It highlights education, healthcare and community development and presents the themes of helping others, building communities, creating opportunities and building a legacy.

title: EGG Coin
content: The presentation describes EGG Coin as a digital currency within the Zyngram digital economic ecosystem. The source associates EGG Coin with transactions, rewards, investments, global payments and ecosystem growth. The presentation describes features including security, decentralization, fast/scalable processing, limited availability and community ownership. These are source claims and are not independently verified in this knowledge base.

title: Account Creation
content: The supplied presentation shows an account-creation flow involving app download/installation, registration details, email OTP verification, phone OTP verification, acceptance of community guidelines and identity/KYC details as applicable. The example also shows a Zyngram ID and wallet/bonus information after registration.

title: Subscription Plans
content: The presentation displays subscription tiers including Free, Basic, Premium, Advance, Ultimate, Pro and an Elite/10K-eligible tier. The displayed examples include Free ₹0, Basic ₹599, Premium ₹1,000, Advance ₹2,500, Ultimate ₹5,000 and Pro ₹10,000. Displayed benefits include referral bonus, wallet usage, subscription usage, recharge usage, withdrawal eligibility, access, offers, support, badges and validity. These prices and benefits are source-specific and may change; they should be treated as the versioned content of the supplied source. CATEGORY 2 — SERVICES

content: The supplied materials describe a Zyngram wallet and reward concepts associated with activities, purchases, subscriptions, referrals and service usage. CATEGORY 3 — FRANCHISE

title: Physical Franchise Structure
content: The physical franchise network is presented as Point → Center → Hub → Command. The brochure describes the physical model as a network of physical outlets providing local presence and supporting service and business activities.

title: Zyngram Point
content: The brochure describes the Point as a local physical outlet focused on one service category. Functions shown include onboarding service providers, generating local customers, supporting orders/services and category-focused marketing.

title: Zyngram Center
content: The Center is described as a physical branch covering the broader service ecosystem. Functions shown include developing users/subscribers, coordinating Points, generating local business and supporting B2C/B2B development.

title: Zyngram Hub
content: The Hub is described as a district-level branch that develops and coordinates Centers. Functions shown include district-level B2C activity, company onboarding, opportunity distribution and district-level growth/B2B development.

title: Zyngram Command
content: The Command is described as a state/regional level structure that coordinates Hubs. Functions shown include onboarding major businesses, strategic partnerships, network monitoring and state/regional expansion.

title: Zyngram HQ
content: The supplied franchise material also presents HQ/corporate as the higher organizational level associated with national/corporate coordination.

title: Digital Franchise Structure
content: The digital franchise network is presented as Zone → Territory → Region → Nation. The digital model focuses on online operations, user acquisition, subscription promotion, business onboarding, digital marketing, lead generation and geographic expansion.

title: Zyngram Digital Node
content: The supplied franchise material refers to digital-node participation within the digital franchise/network model.

title: Zyngram Zone
content: The Zone is described as a digital-first operating level focused on user acquisition, subscription promotion, business onboarding leads, online marketing and lead conversion.

title: Zyngram Territory
content: The Territory develops and coordinates Zones and is associated with territory-level digital campaigns, B2B opportunities, business relationships and network expansion.

title: Zyngram Region
content: The Region coordinates Territories and is associated with regional digital strategy, campaigns, B2B opportunities and strategic partnerships.

title: Zyngram Nation
content: The Nation is described as the national network level, coordinating Regions and supporting national strategy, B2B opportunities, major partnerships and campaigns.

title: Franchise Onboarding Process
content: The brochure presents an onboarding sequence: Express Interest → Discussion & Guidance → Document Verification → Agreement Signing → Training & Setup → Launch Operations → Grow & Expand. The displayed ongoing support includes account management, business setup, training and skill development, marketing materials, operational support, growth strategies, new business opportunities and community/network support.

title: Franchise Geographic Levels
content: The brochure associates Point with a local area, Center with a city/area, Hub with a district, Command with a state/regional level and Nation with a country/corporate network level. Exact availability, territory and exclusivity are dependent on the applicable franchise model and agreement.

title: Franchise Commercial and Revenue Opportunities
content: The brochure lists revenue/opportunity categories such as service/order commissions, business onboarding commissions, subscription commissions, advertising revenue share, B2B revenue/commission, franchise/business onboarding revenue and other approved commercial programs. The source also describes indirect/geographical registration-credit and subscription-commission concepts. The Zyngrammers presentation additionally describes referral, subscription, welcome bonus, achievement, leadership, franchise, business onboarding, working bonus, lead-generation, advertising, consolidated-fund and other opportunity mechanisms. Eligibility, amounts and results depend on the source rules, subscription/status conditions, agreements, activity and applicable policies.

title: Franchise Investment Information
content: The brochure contains investment tables for physical and digital franchise models and displays model-specific figures and fees. One displayed digital example is a Zone starting fee of ₹49,999 + GST. The brochure also displays other model-specific amounts and separate opportunities such as an Employment & Skill Development Centre and a State Directorate Franchise. These figures are source-specific and should not be treated as universal or permanent pricing; applicable agreements, policies and model/category conditions govern the actual terms.

title: Additional Franchise Opportunity Systems
content: The presentation contains sections describing an 8-level referral model, subscription-aware affiliate income, working bonus pools, a super working bonus pool, welcome bonuses, royalty rewards, achievement systems and a Zyngrammer Life Achievement System. These mechanisms are presented as source-defined programs with eligibility and reward rules. Exact thresholds, percentages and rewards must be retrieved from the corresponding approved source version rather than inferred.
